title: Law to set up e-bike trade-in program
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to run a program letting people trade in Class 3 e-bikes and similar unauthorized powered bicycles for a Class 1 or Class 2 e-bike or a retailer voucher. DOT would partner with e-bike retailers to hold at least one trade-in event per community district each year, aiming for 10,000 trade-ins, and could not limit eligibility by occupation or income. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
